items.statement: Both supplied anionic complex states are treated with the correct identities and validated as stationary minima before comparison.
items.expected: Singlet charge −1/multiplicity 1 and triplet charge −1/multiplicity 3 are each optimized or otherwise established as minima, with zero imaginary vibrational modes and traceable evidence.

items.statement: The validated triplet-minus-singlet Gibbs free-energy gap reproduces the current paper's reported result.
The triplet electronic analysis supports the authors' qualitative donor-to-acceptor assignment.
